IBM.assessment: International Business Machines common stock retained; no in-window split (issuer 1979 next 1997).20 vendor cash dividends. Later 2021 Kyndryl separation is outside horizon and affects retrospective vendor units. No in-window terminal/successor exchange identified; dividend reconstruction relies on vendor adjusted close.
IBM.limitations: Absence of a terminal event is an issuer-lineage/vendor-history assessment, not a comprehensive independent corporate-actions database. Continuous daily observations do not alone prove that every distribution adjustment is correct.

GE.assessment: Historical General Electric conglomerate common stock, not an investment in the later standalone aviation business. Pinned vendor events record 2:1 May 26 1987 and 20 cash dividends; original GE 1987 splitannouncement not independently retrieved. Current issuer FAQ documents 2021 reverse split and 2023/24 separations outside Jan 1992 horizon. Uniform retrospective unit scaling cancels in within-window ratios; reconstruction of all distributions is a vendor assumption. Operating-business acquisitions do not automatically exchange GE shareholders’ holdings. No in-window delisting, bankruptcy or terminal successor mapping applied.
GE.limitations: Absence of a terminal event is an issuer-lineage/vendor-history assessment, not a comprehensive independent corporate-actions database. Continuous daily observations do not alone prove that every distribution adjustment is correct.
